package argojob
import ("encoding/json";"os";"path/filepath";"testing")
func TestExportNonrootControllerInputs(t *testing.T) {
 dir:=os.Getenv("OBERTH_NONROOT_FIXTURE_DIR");if dir=="" {t.Fatal("proof directory required")}
 for _,shape:=range []string{"container","script"} {
  wf:=nonrootBuiltWithScratch(t,shape=="script","128Mi")
  body,err:=json.MarshalIndent(wf,"","  ");if err!=nil {t.Fatal(err)}
  if err=os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir,shape+".json"),body,0600);err!=nil {t.Fatal(err)}
 }
}
